summary.zh-Hant: 亞馬遜上游（厄瓜多東部、卡克塔與普圖馬約一帶）的歸屬：厄瓜多、秘魯、哥倫比亞三國的主張互相重疊。資料集把整塊畫給厄瓜多（向東到西經 70 度附近，是厄瓜多主張的最大範圍）；秘魯與哥倫比亞的主張範圍沒有可用的形狀，所以地圖上沒有畫出重疊範圍。本筆只涵蓋 1908-01-01～1916-07-15 這一筆厄瓜多紀錄；之後到 1942 年的爭議還沒有處理。
summary.en: Ownership of the upper Amazon (eastern Ecuador, the Caquetá and Putumayo region), where the claims of Ecuador, Peru and Colombia overlapped. The dataset gives the whole area to Ecuador (its maximum claim, east to about 70°W); no usable shapes exist for the Peruvian and Colombian claims, so no overlap is drawn. Covers only the Ecuador record of 1908-01-01 to 1916-07-15.

position.zh-Hant: 主張亞馬遜上游屬厄瓜多。Shepherd, Historical Atlas（1911）pp. 214–215「South America」 在這一帶標「Claimed by Ecuador」（B 級）；兩套地圖集都只把安地斯山區與沿海畫成確定屬厄瓜多。這筆紀錄的範圍取自資料集，畫的是主張的最大範圍，不是當時實際管轄的範圍。
position.en: Claimed the upper Amazon. Shepherd 1911 labels the area "Claimed by Ecuador" (grade B); both atlases show only the Andes and the coast as undisputedly Ecuadorian. This record draws the maximum claim, not the area actually administered.

position.zh-Hant: 主張同一帶屬秘魯。Shepherd, Historical Atlas（1911）pp. 214–215「South America」 標「Claimed by Peru」，Cambridge Modern History Atlas（1924 年版）Map 135「South America in 1910」 以斜線標為爭議區（各 B 級）。主張的範圍沒有可用的形狀，所以沒有畫；資料庫裡秘魯的紀錄不含這一帶。
position.en: Claimed the same area. Shepherd 1911 labels it "Claimed by Peru"; the Cambridge atlas hatches it as disputed (grade B each). No usable shape for the extent of the claim, so none is drawn.

position.zh-Hant: 主張卡克塔、普圖馬約一帶屬哥倫比亞。兩套地圖集都把哥倫比亞東南部畫成與秘魯、厄瓜多主張重疊的爭議區（各 B 級）。主張的範圍沒有可用的形狀，所以沒有畫。
position.en: Claimed the Caquetá and Putumayo region. Both atlases show south-eastern Colombia as overlapping with the Peruvian and Ecuadorian claims (grade B each). No usable shape for the extent of the claim, so none is drawn.
